question: Should maintainers sponsor a narrowly rebased autoreview/pre-commit-only PR, or explicitly approve reviewing this broad synchronization as a coordinated release change?
rationale: The branch’s stated cleanup does not explain the unrelated product and release changes, and the protected maintainer label requires human ownership of any intentional combined landing.

options.title: Request a narrow replacement PR
options.body: Keep only autoreview secret scanning, pre-commit cleanup, and directly related tests, then review the security-boundary change independently.

options.title: Sponsor the coordinated sync
options.body: Explicitly assign owners for each unrelated product area and review the branch as a deliberate multi-surface release integration.

recommendation.title: Request a narrow replacement PR
recommendation.body: Keep only autoreview secret scanning, pre-commit cleanup, and directly related tests, then review the security-boundary change independently.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the synchronization branch and can explain whether the broad diff is intentional or should be split.
